instruction_provenance: Derived generation instructions, not verbatim book quotations

base-accent.evidence: 占据较大面积的色彩（基色调）构成配色基础
base-accent.instruction: Keep the assigned base on existing large regions, auxiliary colours on existing medium regions, and accents on small existing details. Do not enlarge or add objects to meet colour coverage.

equal-opposition.evidence: 相同面积比例的两种相反色系
equal-opposition.instruction: Give the two assigned colour families comparable visual area within authorized existing regions; distinguish their tones without redesigning the composition.

interior-three-level.instruction: Interior-only soft targets: existing floor/walls/ceiling base about 60-70%, existing furniture/curtains auxiliary about 20-30%, existing accessories accents under 10%. Preserve geometry and protected colours; never add objects or repaint protected regions to satisfy percentages.

gradation.instruction: Within the authorized existing regions, order colour transitions by hue or value. Do not add a background gradient, change lighting, or rearrange objects.

separation.instruction: Keep assigned neighbouring colour regions distinguishable by value differences; use only palette colours and existing boundaries, without new outlines or colour blocks.

templates.tone: For authorized regions only, use NCD {code} ({name}): {description}. This is a qualitative tone instruction, not an exact numeric threshold or global colour filter.
templates.hex_note: (approximate swatch {hex}; provenance {source}; not a pixel-exact target)
templates.protection: Protected existing regions, retaining their original intrinsic colours: {regions}.

non_compiling_examples.note: These are separate base:accent examples, not a universal whole-frame split or a ratio between accents. Do not automatically compile them.
